title: Add gameplay-readiness audit report for SRD pack
description:
Problem:
Current audits are strong for source coverage, suspicious text, table links, and advancement, but they do not summarize whether records are usable by:
1. the primary DM model through discoverable, well-linked records, and
2. deterministic tools through typed choices, grants, filters, and mechanics projections.

Implement:
- Add a gameplay-readiness report to the audit bundle.
- Summarize, by record kind:
  - total records.
  - records with structured choices.
  - records with unresolved choice-bearing prose.
  - records with deterministic grants.
  - records with mechanics projections.
  - records that remain prose-only.
- Include high-impact examples and direct record ids.
- Make the report stable enough to compare between audit bundles.

Acceptance criteria:
- The report would have surfaced the 2026-06-29 findings around option catalogs and equipment modeling.
- The report is generated as part of the audit bundle.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Completed together in PR: traps now expose category trap with schema/tests/generated pack updates; verifier/importer summaries report final record-kind and hazard-category counts; rogue fixed equipment sourceText normalized; audit bundle emits gameplay-readiness report.
